So it is iterating like `thisWindow = r[1] - r[0]`, `thisWindow = r[2] - r[0]`, `thisWindow = r[3] - r[1]` for `thisWindow.SQLUsage.SQLTotal = rotatedSubWindows[i].SQLUsage.SQLTotal - startWindow.SQLUsage.SQLTotal`?

I don't quite understand what you want to do, but is the distance of `2` between windows intended?
Should we use debug level here?
Emm and this log message seems too casual, could you make it more formal? 🤔
